$comment: The one place the brand lives. `bun run brand` writes it into tauri.conf.json and tauri.test.conf.json; the release workflow reads it with jq; a unit test fails when they drift. Provisional until the user settles the name: change it here, run `bun run brand`, done. What does NOT derive from it, on purpose: the bundle identifier (ai.nikcli.ade: the data directory, the WebView2 profile and the secrets of every installed copy hang off it), the executable name (ade-desktop: an update closes the running copy by that name), the ade-v tag prefix and the updater endpoint.
name: ADE
description: ADE runs coding agents side by side in one window: sessions, files, browser and voice.
